brief_summary: Annotated cross-section of the Tecsee Sapphire V2 switch showing the sparkled polycarbonate-on-polycarbonate housing, the UHMWPE stem, the tactile bump positioned near the top of the 3.8mm travel labeled with its 55g actuation force, and a rounded, softened bottom-out region labeled 63.5g, with a small sound-wave glyph reading 'muted, creamy.'
